Maya (Sales): NimbusTech wants a quick joint POC next week. They need SAML SSO, a peered staging tenant (eu-west-1), egress allowlist, and a telemetry export for cost reconciliation. Can infra + solutions triage?
Tom (NimbusTech): Correct. POC profile: ~50k requests/day, ~250 tokens/req, no streaming. Goal: validate SSO and ensure egress works for our firewall. Also want a rough cost estimate.
Evan (Eng-Infra): We'll need their IdP metadata and partner CIDRs. Suggested allowlist:
- Redwood egress: 34.82.10.0/24, 34.82.11.0/24
- API host: api.redwood.example:443
Priya (Solutions): Cost ballpark: 50k * 250 = 12.5M tokens/day. At example $0.0006/token => $7.5k/day. Two-week POC ~ $105k. Enabling batching & caching could cut this 30%+. I can run a sim if you share traces.
Tom (NimbusTech): Uploading sample requests and our NetOps contact now.
Evan (Eng-Infra): Setup ETA: SSO config + test 1 day, VPC peering rules 1 day (depends on partner), tenant + telemetry hook 0.5 day. Rough total ~2.5 days.
Maya (Sales): Thanks. I'll create the runbook and schedule a 30-min kickoff.
ops-bot: Meeting created "NimbusTech POC kickoff" on 2024-06-14 09:30 UTC.
Tom (NimbusTech): Thanks all, will send metadata shortly.
